head_coach.name: Sébastien Migné
head_coach.play_style_summary: Focuses on a highly compact defensive block that willingly concedes possession, restricting space for opponents and looking to transition rapidly to release quick and direct-running forwards in 1v1 situations.

key_players.name: Wilson Isidor
key_players.performance_stats: Recorded 81% shot attempts and 48% aerial duels won for Sunderland in the 2025/26 Premier League season. Has 2 goals in 5 international caps for Haiti.

key_players.name: Josué Casimir
key_players.performance_stats: Played 31 matches in Ligue 1 for AJ Auxerre in the 2025/26 season, registering a 78.9% pass completion rate and 1,521 minutes of play.

key_players.name: Danley Jean Jacques
key_players.performance_stats: Boasts a 59% defensive contributions rating on FotMob. Has 29 senior caps and 6 international goals for Haiti, protecting the midfield and facilitating transitions.
